editorial.headline: Granite Goods Manufacturing, Open Nationally and Usable in Bali
editorial.standfirst: This activity covers the making of granite household pieces, building materials, and furniture, with full foreign ownership nationally and no Bali moratorium block recorded.
editorial.body:
KBLI 23962 is for manufacturers turning granite into finished goods, not merely trading stone or installing it on site. Its scope is practical and product-led: granite tabletops, ornaments, and statues for household or display use; granite tiles and bathtubs for building purposes; and granite tables and chairs for furniture. The common thread is the making of objects from granite, with the finished item determining the activity’s commercial identity.

The record is unusually broad on scale. It is open to Mikro, Kecil, Menengah, and Besar operators, so the same activity can describe anything from a compact workshop making decorative granite pieces to a larger industrial operation producing building materials or furniture. That breadth matters because the category is not limited to one buyer type. A registrant may be serving homes, interiors, construction inputs, or furniture demand, as long as the underlying activity remains the manufacture of goods from granite.

Nationally, the foreign-investment position is clean: the activity is marked TERBUKA, with a pma_max_asing of 100. In plain English, a PMA structure is nationally open up to full foreign ownership. The record cites Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021 as the source for that position. There is no partial foreign-equity cap in the national field, so the important national message is not one of restriction but of eligibility.

Bali adds a separate filter, and here the result is also workable. The provincial moratorium rule recorded here blocks all Low and Medium-Low risk activities for PMA across Bali, but this activity is not blocked by that moratorium. The reason given is that, at Besar scale, the OSS risk is Menengah-Tinggi/Tinggi, which places it outside the blocked Low and Medium-Low band. The Bali status is therefore not a contradiction of the national opening: on this slim record, granite goods manufacturing is nationally open to PMA and not blocked for PMA registration in Bali by the moratorium.
